name: qwen3:4b
note: Default on 16 GB: native tool calling and optional thinking. Measured at 8k context.

name: qwen3:8b
note: Better answers than the 4B; needs a larger memory budget than the 8 GB default on 16 GB machines. Measured at 8k context.

name: qwen2.5-coder:7b
note: The default code model; fits the 8 GB budget next to the decision model. Measured at 8k context.

name: qwen2.5vl:7b
note: Reads images and screenshots. Too big to sit next to the decision model on 16 GB, so noskill unloads that while it runs. Measured at 8k context.

name: llama3.2:3b
note: Small and fast; calls tools often when it shouldn't. Estimated size.

name: gemma3:4b
note: Small model that also reads images. Estimated size.

name: tev1:0.8b
note: Decision model for routing and judging; 1.7 GB, up to 2.7 GB with its prompt cache. Default on 16 GB.

name: tev1
note: Larger decision model for machines above 16 GB; its prompt cache can grow to about 13 GB. Estimated base size.

name: nomic-embed-text
note: Embedding model for skill selection and local search. Estimated size.
